issue.title: Close summary entry_line is empty when Work Log inserts shift the Pomodoros section
issue.description:
`build_close_summary_json` sets `entry_line` by indexing `ledger.contents` at `running.line`. `plan_pomodoro_close` then replaces `ledger.contents` with the staged day file after `write_logs` inserts Work Log lines above `## Pomodoros`, while `running.line` stays the pre-image index. `plan_pomodoro_close_item` copies that string into the top-level `task_line`.

The index no longer names the closed headline. It often lands on a blank line, so both fields are empty. `locate_close_headline` already refuses an empty `entry_line` and finds the rewritten headline for `pomodoro_blocks`. The close card and any consumer of `entry_line` / `task_line` still see the blank.

This predates epic bob-cli-2r. The staged overwrite is in `plan_pomodoro_close` from the 2026-09-29 close split (`f8b03c2`). The epic's plan pins `pomodoro_close` item JSON byte for byte and only required block-ref indices to survive the shift. Test `capture_pomodoro_close_tracks_blocks_past_day_file_work_log` covers that layout for blocks and does not assert `entry_line`.

task_type_fields.impact: The Mac close card and any JSON consumer that shows `task_line` or `pomodoro_close.entry_line` render a blank headline when the closed Pomodoro's task lives in the same day file above `## Pomodoros`. The block preview is unaffected. Nothing is written incorrectly; the close itself still rewrites the headline.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/capture/pomodoro_close.rs build_close_summary_json entry_line; task_line copy in plan_pomodoro_close_item
task_type_fields.repro:
Use the day file from `tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_close.rs` `capture_pomodoro_close_tracks_blocks_past_day_file_work_log`: a `^build` task above `## Pomodoros`, running CAPTURE `0920-0950`, `BOB_NOW=2026-09-28 09:37:00`, capture `=x`.

Read `json["pomodoro_close"]["entry_line"]` and `json["task_line"]`. Both come from `ledger.contents.lines().nth(running.line - 1)` after the staged day file has been shifted by the Work Log insert (`src/native/capture/pomodoro_close.rs` around the `entry_line` assignment, and `task_line: summary.entry_line.clone()` in `plan_pomodoro_close_item`). `src/native/capture_pomodoro_close/linked_tasks.rs` `plan_pomodoro_close` assigns `ledger.contents = planner.staged[day_path]` after `write_logs`.

Expected: `entry_line` and `task_line` are the closed headline `- [x] (**0920-0940** [t:: 20m]) — CAPTURE`. Observed by bob-cli-2r.1, and still the code path: they are empty because the pre-image index hits a blank line in the shifted text.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-2r.1 found that a day-file task close leaves pomodoro_close.entry_line and the top-level task_line empty. This epic only repaired block refs and pinned the close JSON, so the summary defect stays outside it.
